title: Homogeneous section tensor powers and standard-open locus on polynomial Proj
statement: Let k be a field and P=Proj k[x_0,x_1] with its standard grading [def-sc-p1-standard]. For d>0 and homogeneous f of degree d, let L=O_P(d) be the twist [def-weil-pbc-proj-twisting-sheaf] and sigma the global section f/1. Then L is invertible [def-sc-invertible-module], sigma has nonvanishing locus [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module] equal to D_+(f), and there are isomorphisms a_n:L^{tensor n} ~= O_P(nd) and b_mn:O_P(m) tensor L^{tensor n} ~= O_P(m+nd) for every n in N and m in Z. The composite sigma^{tensor n} followed by a_n equals the canonical section f^n. The composite O_P(m) ~= O_P(m) tensor O_P -> O_P(m) tensor L^{tensor n} -> O_P(m+nd), using sigma^{tensor n} and b_mn, equals multiplication by f^n.

proof.text: Obtain the degree-one coordinate cover from proj_polynomial_twist_chart k 1, and apply Proj.isInvertible_twist to show O(d) invertible.
Apply the strict tensor-power and multiplication-data component to obtain the two isomorphism families and their morphism identities.
Apply the strict locus component and assemble the conjunction with invertibility and the data.

proof_origin.note: Assemble the three strict components; invertibility follows from the existing chart cover and Proj.isInvertible_twist.

lean.statement: theorem proj_homogeneous_section_tensor_powers (k : Type u) [Field k] {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) {f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k} (hf : f ∈ MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k d) : let L := Proj.twist (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) (0 + (d : ℤ)) L.IsInvertible ∧ ((Proj.basicOpen (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f : (Proj (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k)).Opens) : Set _) = nonvanishingLocus L ((Proj.unitToTwist hf).app ⊤ (unitSectionsEquiv ⊤ 1)) ∧ ∃ (a : ∀ n : ℕ, L.tensorPow n ≅ Proj.twist (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) (0 + ((n • d : ℕ) : ℤ))) (b : ∀ (m : ℤ) (n : ℕ), Proj.twist (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) m ⊗ L.tensorPow n ≅ Proj.twist (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) (m + ((n • d : ℕ) : ℤ))), (∀ n : ℕ, tensorPowSection (homOfGlobalSection L ((Proj.unitToTwist hf).app ⊤ (unitSectionsEquiv ⊤ 1))) n ≫ (a n).hom = Proj.unitToTwist (SetLike.pow_mem_graded n hf)) ∧ (∀ (m : ℤ) (n : ℕ), (ρ_ (Proj.twist (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) m)).inv ≫ Proj.twist (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) m ◁ tensorPowSection (homOfGlobalSection L ((Proj.unitToTwist hf).app ⊤ (unitSectionsEquiv ⊤ 1))) n ≫ (b m n).hom = Proj.twistMul m (SetLike.pow_mem_graded n hf))
